description.en: React + TypeScript 组件库，组件按仪表盘、设置流程、弹层、表格这类产品界面切分，自带主题预设与给 AI 用的元数据包。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Calmo UI (https://calmo.booung.org/).
Technology stack: react, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏左边是 DOCS 目录，Overview 下面把组件分成 Layout / Navigation / Icons / Actions / Forms / Feedback / Overlays / Data & Lists / Utilities 九组；中间大标题写 The React component library for calm product surfaces.，右边一块 Install 面板给出 npm install calmo-ui 和 Copy 按钮，并排三格写 126+ documented components、5 theme presets、AI prompt + metadata bundle。下方 WHY CALMO 一段有四张卡：Production UI coverage、TypeScript-first ergonomics、AI-friendly by default、Calm product direction，再往下是 Dashboard starter、Settings and account app、Finance sheet flow 三个示例应用。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
